title: Implement voices page
description:
Create Source/GUI/VoicesPage.h and Source/GUI/VoicesPage.cpp implementing `class VoicesPage : public juce::Component` with complete expert editing for Voice A and Voice B.

Per-voice controls (identical set for A and B, laid out as two columns or two grouped panels): enable, time ratio, fine offset, level, tail scale, adaptive role, pan, width, stereo offset, cross-feedback, HPF frequency, LPF frequency, Presence Guard, transient softening, modulation, drift, diffusion, saturation.

Build the per-voice control set through a small private helper struct so Voice A and Voice B share construction code, with parameter IDs supplied per voice from Source/Parameters/ParameterLayout.h. Use the exact declared ID strings; do not construct IDs by ad-hoc string concatenation unless the layout header itself exposes a helper for that.

The page owns its own APVTS attachments as `std::unique_ptr` members. GUI code never touches the audio thread and reads no DSP state; display-only values must come from TelemetryState if needed.

Before editing, inspect:
- Source/Parameters/ParameterLayout.h (authoritative per-voice parameter IDs and their ranges/defaults)
- Source/GUI/CustomLookAndFeel.h (shared colours)
- Source/PluginProcessor.h (APVTS accessor)

Implement `resized()` with a proportional layout that remains usable in a resizable editor. Do not register the files in CMakeLists.txt; j.8 owns that.
acceptance_criteria: Source/GUI/VoicesPage.h declares class VoicesPage deriving from juce::Component

Source/GUI/VoicesPage.cpp creates controls for enable, time ratio, fine offset, level, tail scale, adaptive role, pan, width, stereo offset, cross-feedback, HPF, LPF, Presence Guard, transient softening, modulation, drift, diffusion, and saturation for both Voice A and Voice B
Voice A and Voice B controls are built through a shared private helper rather than duplicated verbatim twice
Every parameter ID string used in Source/GUI/VoicesPage.cpp matches an ID declared in Source/Parameters/ParameterLayout.h
Source/GUI/VoicesPage.h holds all APVTS attachments as std::unique_ptr members owned by the page
Source/GUI/VoicesPage.cpp implements resized() using a proportional layout and no fixed absolute window size
No file outside the task's allowed_write_paths is created or modified
forbidden_changes: modify Source/PluginProcessor.*, Source/PluginEditor.*, Source/Parameters/*, or any DSP file
modify Source/GUI/CustomLookAndFeel.*, Source/GUI/MeterComponent.*, or any other page file
invent parameter ID strings not present in Source/Parameters/ParameterLayout.h
read DSP or audio-thread state directly from the GUI

allowed: choose the per-voice helper struct shape and layout grouping
choose control styles and label text
forbidden: change voice DSP behaviour or defaults
